methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly and called with a mock copy_from_env function that writes crafted JSON to a temp file. Four scenarios tested per task: (1) do-nothing — raises FileNotFoundError → score=0, passed=False; (2) baseline — all-zeros/False JSON from setup_task.sh → score=0, passed=False; (3) partial — JSON with partial completion (some criteria met, total < 70) → passed=False; (4) full — JSON with all criteria met → score>=70, passed=True. No GeoGebra VM required.
notes: Do-nothing=0 (FileNotFoundError). Baseline=0 (all-false JSON). Partial (file+original_vertices, no dilation/dilated/measurements) = 40 pts < 70. Full (all criteria: dilation+dilated_vertices+measurements+annotation) = 100 pts, passed=True.
verification_method: export_result.sh writes /tmp/task_result.json → copy_from_env → verifier.py reads JSON and applies scoring criteria
